Contributors: Brion de la Tour, Louis, 1743-1803; Esnauts et Rapilly

Hand colored. Relief shown pictorially. Shows area from Quebec to Cape May and from Oswego to Kennebec Bay. Includes "Indication des principaux évenemens de la Guerre actuelle, dans les contrées que comprend cette carte" for the years 1775-1778. On verso, in pencil: Nordamerika Kriegskarte, 1782, [No.] 62. Scale ca. 1:1,200,000. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. Vault AACR2: 651
